description: GEER Hurricane Harvey reconnaissance - initial data collection is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Nina Stark, University of Florida (ufl.edu). Three teams from the Geotechnical Extreme Events Reconnaissance (GEER) Association, supported by the National Science Foundation, were deployed to investigate the impacts of wind, flooding, storm surge and wave forcing in Texas. The teams worked collaboratively with federal, state and local organizations in Texas. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/DS2XD4C. Keywords: GEER, reconnaissance, Hurricane Harvey, geotechnical, coastal, field observations. Published 2018-04-12. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the DesignSafe listing (publication licences offered are CC BY 4.0, ODC-By, CC0 and GPL; project page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
